context: Colored terminal logging plus a plain text log file from one CLI

checklist.name: profile_per_writer
checklist.description: Gives each destination its own color profile: either a logger per writer (`log.New(os.Stderr)` and `log.New(file)`, with a small fan out), or a single logger whose file side strips escape codes (for example `ansi.Strip`) while the profile is set for the terminal. A single logger on `io.MultiWriter` detects no terminal and writes plain text to both, or ANSI to both if a profile is forced.

checklist.name: no_multiwriter_logger
checklist.description: Does not create one Charm logger over `io.MultiWriter(os.Stderr, file)` as the only logger without handling the profile difference.

checklist.name: level_both
checklist.description: Applies the level from `--verbose` to every logger (`log.DebugLevel` or `log.InfoLevel`), so the file and the terminal agree.

checklist.name: timestamps
checklist.description: Enables timestamps on every logger (`ReportTimestamp: true` or `SetReportTimestamp(true)`); `log.New` has them off by default.

checklist.name: even_kv
checklist.description: Passes key value pairs in even numbers after the message; an odd count prints `ErrMissingValue`.
